speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with exercise?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had the cough and shortness of breath for about three months now. The breathing gets noticeably worse when I climb stairs or walk up hills, but it doesn't seem to bother me much at night. However, this is a low-resource clinic. There is no equipment for ECG or labs. You must reach a cardiac diagnosis from clinical findings only.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
